tasks.short: Consult or train on mechatronics and automated control.

steps.what: Read actual participant questions, control-system context and approved technical material
Prepare and check actual mechatronics examples and training materials
outputs: checked final training examples and materials

steps.what: Save the checked final training materials
inputs: checked final training examples and materials

steps.what: Explain actual mechatronic/control concepts, demonstrate examples and answer participant questions
outputs: actual technical consultation or training outcomes

inputs: actual technical consultation or training outcomes

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} source views and reusable mechatronics example layouts. Actual consultation, demonstrations and learner questions stay human, with actual instruction outcomes recorded after delivery rather than inferred from prepared materials.

tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and reusable example fields.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining interacting mechanical, electronic and control behaviour.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt examples and advice to actual participant understanding.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated material preparation; instruction responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native technical-source links and example templates reduce preparation without delivering mechatronics training.

assumptions: Boundary is a prepared consultation/training session and its existing outcome record. Participants supply actual questions; system owner supplies actual diagrams/version; engineer retrieves and manually resolves missing context in s1 and selects/enters examples in s2. Actual delivery outcomes arise in s4 and are captured in s5, never before. Brief consultation without materials/records requires observed reweighting.

Inspect actual contractor installation, integration and test work against requirements
Discuss actual defects, sequencing and corrective expectations with contractors
Write and check final issue details, evidence links and actual contractor recipient

inputs: checked final contractor issue and recipient

tasks.short: Publish engineering design and qualification reports.

steps.what: Verify actual design revisions, qualification evidence and report scope
Select technical conclusions, qualification status and explicit design limitations
Populate engineering report tables and design figures from selected records
outputs: draft engineering report tables and figures

steps.what: Write engineering report explanations from actual design and qualification evidence
inputs: draft engineering report tables and figures

loop.input: verified design/test pack and engineer conclusions
loop.output: draft report prose with exact evidence references and limitations
loop.check: Engineer checks design meaning, tested configuration, failure omissions, qualification scope and unsupported pass claims against actual evidence
loop.stop: Missing test, changed configuration or two failed checks requires manual prose
loop.why_not_simpler: Native tables and headings first; varied design explanation needs bounded prose

steps.what: Check complete final report, release permissions and intended publication audience
outputs: checked final report and publication audience

steps.what: Save the final engineering report
inputs: checked final report and publication audience

steps.what: Publish the final report to the authorised internal engineering audience
inputs: checked final report and publication audience

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER}-to-{DOCS} report tables before bounded narrative drafting. Engineer selects conclusions and checks the complete final report before separate save and internal publication; no test completion or qualification pass is inferred.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated evidence transfer and engineering narrative composition.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked outputs and source-grounded drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Correct tested configuration, qualification scope and failed-test interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: State what actual evidence establishes and what remains unproven.
tasks.altitude: Less report preparation; technical release responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native report links and bounded prose drafting reduce repeated engineering-report preparation without deciding qualification status.

assumptions: Boundary includes report preparation and publication. Design owner supplies actual revision, requirements and figures; test owner actual run ID, configuration, method, result, unit and exceptions. Engineer verifies in s1, selects conclusions and specific outputs in s2; missing evidence is manually resolved, not fabricated. No free labelled qualification outcomes.

Native first; existing links and runtime yield zero saving. Provisional table15 is human transfer/layout, actual evidence20 and conclusions20 unchanged. Ordinary complete-report QA19 retained; save1 and publication1 retained. Internal publication assumed authorised; external audience requires act_external and actual final release authority after complete version exists. Shares unmeasured.
unknowns: Actual report repetition and publication authority

tasks.short: Upgrade devices by adding mechatronic elements.

steps.what: Inspect actual device constraints and requirements for the proposed upgrade
Choose actual mechanical, electronic and control architecture for the upgrade
Draw chosen mechanical interfaces and actuator/sensor placements in mechanical CAD
Draw selected electronic connections and component references in electrical CAD
Implement actual selected device-control logic in the engineering development environment
Test actual integrated upgrade behaviour and judge design adequacy and safety
Record and check actual upgrade design, test findings and remaining limitations
Save the actual device-upgrade record

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} mechanical/electrical CAD component objects, symbols and linked references. Engineer selects the actual mechatronic architecture, implements control logic and tests integrated behaviour; repeated drawings reduce without automatic device redesign.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated CAD objects, connections and component references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parameterised component objects and electrical symbols.
tasks.still_hard: Mechanical/electronic/control interaction and safe integrated behaviour.
tasks.human_edge: Choose and validate a workable device upgrade.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated drawing; device-design responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native mechanical and electrical CAD libraries reduce repeated drawing without choosing a mechatronic architecture or proving safe control behaviour.

assumptions: Boundary includes engineer device upgrade through actual test/findings record, not manufacturing release. Device owner supplies actual geometry/interfaces and requirements; component suppliers actual dimensions, electrical attributes and revisions. Engineer verifies in s1, selects placement and connections in s2, enters actual objects in s3/s4, implements logic in s5 and performs own integration work/tests in s6. Unsupported components manually drawn; prototype fabrication by others is not removed focal labour.

Native first; existing object libraries/configuration yield zero saving. Provisional drafting reductions cover repetition only, real placements and connections retained. Constraints15, architecture30, control10, integration/test15, actual findings4 and save1 unchanged. Shares unmeasured; no control deployment or production release is inferred.
unknowns: Actual CAD library coverage and upgrade/test effort
research_questions: Can native objects preserve chosen interfaces and actual component revisions?
